text:
jess: Heads up — just got multiple reports that the JS SDK v1.3.7 breaks on Edge deployments (Vercel edge runtime). Error: "SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module" and sourcemaps are missing in stack traces. Anyone see this in CI or local?

sam: Yup, got 2 support tickets this morning. They included a stack that points to /node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.mjs but the package seems inconsistent. Can you share the package.json from the published tarball?

jess: grabbing from the npm pack I ran locally. pasted below:
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/sdk",
  "version": "1.3.7",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
      "import": "./dist/index.cjs"
    }
  }
}
```

jess: Oops — exports.import points to .cjs. Also the npm pack is missing dist/index.mjs.map and, weirdly, dist/index.mjs in one tarball I inspected.

matt: That explains it. Edge runtimes expect ESM entrypoints. If exports.import points to a .cjs file, Node resolution will hand back CJS which V8 isolates choke on. Two separate problems: wrong exports mapping and rollup/publish omitted some artifacts (.mjs and .map).

sam: Short-term: we should unpublish or untag 1.3.7 and publish 1.3.8 ASAP with fixes. Long-term: add a publish validation step that npm pack + tarlist asserts presence of .mjs, .cjs, .d.ts, and .map files.

jess: Plan I'm going to follow now:
1) yank 1.3.7 tag on npm (unpublish if still allowed)
2) open patch bump 1.3.8 that updates exports import -> "./dist/index.mjs" and keeps require -> ./dist/index.cjs
3) ensure rollup config writes source maps and files are included in package.json files array (include dist/*.map)
4) add CI check in release workflow to run `npm pack` and validate contents

ci-bot: [release-check] automated check for package @redwood/sdk@1.3.7 failed: missing files in npm pack: dist/index.mjs, dist/index.mjs.map. See CI artifact: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/actions/runs/12345678 for tarball listing.

sam: Also add a tiny unit in the edge/e2e matrix that runs a simple import in the edge-like runtime (node --conditions=... / or playwright on a tiny worker) to catch resolution issues before publish.

matt: Quick patch suggestion in case it helps reviewers: 
```diff
-  "exports": {
-    ".": {
-      "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
-      "import": "./dist/index.cjs"
-    }
-  }
+  "exports": {
+    ".": {
+      "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
+      "import": "./dist/index.mjs"
+    }
+  }
```

jess: thanks @matt — I'll open PR and add the pack-check. Will also include a changelog note apologizing to anyone hit by the edge break. cc @sam to verify the support tickets once 1.3.8 is out. :pray: 

sam: 👍 once patched I'll re-try with the affected customer and confirm.

matt: I'll update rollup config to always emit sourcemaps and add a test for types: ensure dist/index.d.ts exists in the pack.

jess: pushing the fix now and creating the release PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/432 — adding reviewers.
